user.title: MAC Registry
user.description: Builds a read-only table linking MAC, IP and hostname to your Home Assistant devices and entities. No network scan, nothing is renamed or modified.

data_description.scan_interval: The table is also refreshed on registry and router tracker changes.
data_description.router_integrations: Leave empty to use every device tracker whose source is a router.
data_description.ignore_random: Locally administered MACs (second digit 2, 6, A or E). When kept they are flagged and never raise a repair.
data_description.use_dhcp: Reads the cache Home Assistant already keeps. Disabled automatically if it is not available.

add_override.title: Add a manual link
add_override.description: A manual link always wins over automatic matching. A label alone removes the MAC from the orphan list.

error.invalid_mac: This is not a valid MAC address.
error.override_empty: Choose a device or enter a label.

abort.not_loaded: MAC Registry must be loaded to edit manual links.

unseen_devices.name: Devices never seen by the router

lookup.name: Look up
lookup.description: Finds the device behind a MAC, an IP, a hostname or a raw log line.

query.name: Query
query.description: MAC, IP, hostname or a log line copied as is.

export.name: Export
export.description: Returns the whole table and can write it as CSV or Markdown in the configuration folder.

path.name: File
path.description: Optional, relative to the configuration folder, ending in .csv or .md (for example mac_registry.md).

format.name: Format
format.description: Optional, deduced from the file extension.

orphan_macs.title: {count} MAC(s) on your network without a Home Assistant device

duplicate_macs.title: {count} MAC(s) declared by several devices

path_outside_config.message: The file {path} must be inside the configuration folder.

path_hidden.message: The file {path} cannot be in a hidden folder.

path_extension.message: The file {path} must end in .csv or .md and match the requested format.

path_no_directory.message: The folder of {path} does not exist.
